description: Stateful monitor, one parameter: /monitor?url=<your openapi.json>. The baseline token is derived from the URL, so the first call stores a baseline and every later call with the same url returns only what changed. Price: $0.01 per call in USDC on Base (eip155:8453), paid with x402 in params._meta["x402/payment"]. HTTP: GET https://api.firstmention.uk/s/api-change-check/monitor
